sources: https://www.nedo.go.jp/library/fuuryoku/case/pref_01.html (… pref_47: NEDO 日本における風力発電設備・導入実績, as of Mar 2018)
notes: Japan: Fukushima FORWARD (14 MW floating) decommissioned 2021; Setana/Sakata early port turbines are marginal 'offshore'. Reference end-2024 346 MW.

Japan: NEDO per-prefecture list (to Mar 2018) for farms >=1 MW; post-2018 farms from windfarm.work / operator sites. NEDO pages for Saitama, Yamanashi, Nagano, Osaka, Okayama, Hiroshima, Kagawa are PDF-only and were not parsed (all small, <~30 MW total, except Okayama/Hiroshima minor sites).

Japan de-duplication vs base data: skipped Tomamae Winvilla (Dream Up Tomamae 30.6 MW), Iwaya Eco Power, Mutsu-Ogawara (Cosmo), Koriyama Nunobiki, Shin-Izumo, Ikata Eco Park, Hirogawa-Hidakagawa, Shin-Aoyama, Kamisu 1/2, Choshi/Kitakyushu demos, Setana 1.2 MW town turbines, Summit Wind Sakata 16 MW (assumed = base "Sakata Port / Setana"), and all Eurus Dohoku farms (Ashikawa 128.8, Kawaminami 80, Yuchi 72.2, Kawanishi 64, Hamasato 47.5, Kabaoka 42 = 434.5 MW, fully operating 2023) which the base file carries as one 340 MW "Dohoku cluster" entry (under-counted by ~95 MW).

Base-file issues noticed (not changed here): JPN "Iwaya Ecopower" coords 36.14,136.43 are in Ishikawa - the farm is at Higashidori, Aomori (~41.44,141.43) and was decommissioned 2023-03; "Mutsu-Ogawara" (Cosmo) ended 2023-03 and "Tomamae Winvilla" was repowered 2023-10.
